items.item_text: Certified Diabetes Educator
Bachelors in Arts or Science (preferred in Nutrition and Dietetics)

Under the supervision of the Practice Manager, Clinical Director and Medical Director for the Men’s Clinic at UCLA Health, oversee the development and implementation of the nutritional component for Men’s Health.
Develop a nutritional care plan for the patient throughout their care journey in the center.
Provide educational classes for patients, evaluate inpatient nutrition, be a resource for patients, and assist in facilitating support groups.
Apply current research finds in clinical care and participate in applied research as appropriate.
Interact with all health care team members.
Work with clients on novel weight loss drugs like GLPs and function as part of weight loss task force with NP and LVN.
Registered Dietitian (RD) by the Commission on Dietetic Registration
